text:
Priya (PM): quick sync — greenroom instrumentation checkpoint. need minimal deliverables for next sprint to unblock enterprise P0s: dashboards (cost + error), tracing hooks for tail latencies, cost breakdown per-route. acceptance criteria: 1) dashboards show 95/99 latency and per-model cost, 2) tracing hooks capture KV cache hits and model variant fallback events, 3) error analytics surfaces an actionable root cause for top-3 errors. Who can own what?

Sam (Eng): I can take tracing hooks. question: do we want full distributed tracing or lightweight span logs? lightweight spans preferred to keep perf low. propose sample rate 0.5% baseline.

Diego (SRE): for production we should gate at 0.1% for high-qps routes; need sampling config. also require rollout plan and fallback when traces add >5% p90 latency.

Jules (Data): dashboards — minimum panels: token-cost-by-route, cost-per-1000-requests, 95/99 latency per-model, errors-by-surface. need metrics emitted: model_id, route, tokens_out, tokens_in, kv_hit.

Zoe (QA): test plan: synthetic traffic for three slices (low/med/high seq len), failure injection for fallback variant, validate error grouping. I can own test harness.

Priya (PM): thanks. Diego can you draft the rollout gating checklist? Sam, push a PR with the hook prototype and the sampling config by Tue. Jules, make dashboard wireframes — share in this thread. Zoe, add test scenarios into the canary runbook.

Diego (SRE): draft checklist: 1) metrics sanity within 10% of baseline, 2) traces sample size >= 500 spans per hour, 3) no >2% increase in error rate, 4) automatic rollback if p95 latency delta > 10ms. will post soon.

Sam (Eng): quick config sketch:
```
tracing:
  mode: "span-log"
  sample_rate: 0.005 # 0.5%
  high_qps_overrides:
    - route: "/api/generate"
      sample_rate: 0.001
  include_fields: [model_id, route, seq_len, kv_hit, fallback]
```

Priya (PM): good. can we add a metric for 'fallback_count' so cost team can correlate?

Jules (Data): will add fallback_count and compute incremental cost delta per-route in dashboard.

Sam (Eng): added metric emitter for fallback_count in my branch.

Zoe (QA): I'll start smoke runs tomorrow. Can we freeze schema by EOD?

Priya (PM): aim: freeze schema by today EOD, prototype hooks merged by Tue, dashboards mocked by Wed. If blockers, escalate to this thread. :hand:

deploy-bot: Deploy queued for staging: infra/tracing-hooks-poc -> staging (build 5723).

Sam (Eng): noted, will watch logs.

Diego (SRE): +1. will monitor perf and alert on regressions.

Priya (PM): thanks all — short stand at 10 to sync on gaps.
